profile.visual_desc: Muscular elf with flowing blonde hair and blue headband. Wears grey-green tactical plating over a dark blue suit with a large mechanical backpack.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Confident smirk with sharp features. Long yellow hair framing a metallic blue headband and narrow orange eyes.
profile.weapon_desc: Large grey mechanical shoulder-mounted launcher held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Frame 1: Kneeling back-view facing up-left. Launcher held vertically against the right shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Frames 2-3: Lowers launcher to horizontal position. Braces body and aims toward the target area.
profile.step3_impact: Frame 5: Releases a wide, spiraling light-blue energy beam. The blast features a dense core and rotating outer energy wisps.
profile.step4_finish: Frame 6: Character lifts the launcher upward during recoil. Post-fire recovery stance as the energy trail clears.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The horizontal energy beam perfectly aligns with the barrel's trajectory in the firing frame.

evaluation.diagnosis: The animation sequence adheres to the reference frame logic. Pose transitions and VFX alignment are technically consistent.
